title: Phase 85 Housing, Shelter, Land Use And Place Stability Registry
scope: Inactive housing need, supply, approvals, delivery, occupancy, tenure, affordability, habitability, accessibility, public and community ownership, homelessness, shelter, supportive housing, displacement, retrofit, climate, disaster, relocation, reconstruction, right-to-return, and long-horizon place-stability controls assigned one-to-one to the eight Phase 84 community-resource-security chains.
interpretation_boundary: Approved units are not delivered homes; a shelter bed is not stable housing; an affordability label is not household affordability; retrofit spending is not a safe and habitable dwelling; temporary relocation is not a right to return; reconstruction is not community recovery.
activation_rule: No Phase 85 record can open until its Phase 84 predecessor contains adopted production and stewardship, land-water-sovereignty findings, usable provisioning capacity, protected workforces, verified procurement benefit, measured access and nutrition, adequate institutional meals, tested reserves, contamination remedies, circular-flow evidence, long-horizon resource security, independent review, and dated receipts. None does.
